items.name: Wrightsville Beach Sloop Picnic and Beach Blanket
items.alt: Navy picnic blanket printed edge to edge with white sailboats on teal waves, spread on the sand with a basket and glasses at Wrightsville Beach, shown as an illustrative image
items.meta: A printed picnic and beach blanket with a navy sloop pattern edge to edge on a fleece front. A Wrightsville Beach blanket for shore picnics on the Carolina coast.
facts: 61 x 51 in, with a black carrying strap and buckles
100% polyester fleece front, water resistant black oxford back, spot clean
Sailboat pattern printed edge to edge on the fleece side, not embroidered
